explain_tr: Üç arabası varsa zengin olduğuna emin oluruz: must be.
prompt: She has three cars. She ___ be rich.
trap_tr: Can't zıt anlam verir; kanıt eminsen must seçilir.

choices: She must to be tired after that trip.
She must be tired after that long trip.
She has to be tired after that trip.
She must being tired after that trip.
explain_tr: Emin tahmin must + yalın fiildir: must be tired.
prompt: Pick the correct deduction about the tired traveller.

choices: He mustn't be at home; the lights are off.

He must be at home; the lights are off.

explain_tr: Gri gökyüzü kanıttır; belki yağar demek may + yalın fiildir.
prompt: The sky is very grey. It ___ rain before lunch.

He can't be serious about quitting.

prompt: Pick the correct deduction about the shocking news.

explain_tr: Çok kibarsa öyle demiş olması imkânsızdır: can't have said.
prompt: She ___ have said that; she is too polite.
trap_tr: Mustn't yasaklama anlamı verir; geçmiş tahmin can't have ister.

choices: “He must be rich.” = his boss says so.
“He must wear a uniform.” = I guess so.
“He must be rich.” = I guess so (his cars prove it).
“He has to be rich.” = I guess so.
explain_tr: Kanıta dayalı tahmin deduction, kurala dayalı zorunluluk obligation olur.
prompt: Pick the sentence where must is a deduction (guess), not an obligation.

choices: She must shocked by the news.
She must have shock by the news.
She must has been shocked by the news.
She must have been shocked by the news.
explain_tr: Geçmiş tahmin must + have + V3 ile kurulur.
prompt: Pick the correct past deduction about the shocking news.

explain_tr: Belki kaçırdılar demek might + have + V3 olur.
prompt: They ___ have missed the bus; they are very late.
trap_tr: Can have kalıbı olumlu geçmiş tahminde kullanılmaz.

explain_tr: Uçak yeni indiyse varmış olmaları imkânsızdır: can't have arrived.
prompt: They ___ have arrived yet; the flight just landed.
trap_tr: Haven't arrived da doğru cümledir ama tahmin (deduction) değildir.

choices: This must be the right address.
This has to be the right address, I guess.
This must to be the right address.
explain_tr: Emin tahmin must + yalın fiildir; has to tahmin yapmaz.
prompt: Elif found the street name. Pick the correct deduction.
